video_title: ‘We love you & we need you’ 🙌 J.B. Bickerstaff on the advice he would give De'Aaron Fox | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the Knicks' resilience and Mike Brown's coaching
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown has done a heck of a job instilling his system, instilling belief.
quotes.quote: You look at that team and you look at a team that was never rattled. Typically, when you get down like that, if you don't have a team that's together, if you don't have a team that's been through these experiences, they crumble. Mike Brown has done a heck of a job instilling his system, instilling belief, and each individual guy understanding how they all can impact it. Your leadership in Jalen Brunson being unselfish and willing to make the right play down the stretch, if they put two guys on you, it's a simple game, fill the ball to the open man.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff defends Mitch Johnson's coaching performance
quotes.excerpt: The job that Mitch has done has been phenomenal.
quotes.quote: The job that Mitch has done has been phenomenal. You look at how many circumstances and times in coaching where you have to take over for someone like Greg Popovich and being the next coach, typically it doesn't work out well for you. For him to be in his first full year coaching this young team and helping them get to the finals says a lot about his ability to coach a team, his ability to bring team together.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff criticizes the personal nature of coaching criticism
quotes.excerpt: Some of the things that have been said about Mitch and his team crosses the line.
quotes.quote: Some of the things that have been said about Mitch and his team in my opinion crosses the line, especially things that come from people who understand how difficult it is to do that job. If you want to criticize a coach, fine, but there's certain words that people are using now that other people are looking to weaponize and use them against coaches, NBA players, and whoever it may be. We have to be very careful about our choice of words and making sure that we're being critical but not making it personal.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on supporting De'Aaron Fox through criticism

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I know how hard it is to get young guys to buy in to being stars in their role to even get to this point. And De'Aaron Fox has been taking a lot of criticism that I feel that's not warranted. This is his first time on the stage and people are playing the blame game. If you're in that locker room, what is your message to De'Aaron Fox to keep him motivated and keep him going?

text_blocks.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
text_blocks.text: It's just simple. We love you and we need you. We understand what his talents are and how good he's been as an All-Star before, as a floor leader, as a floor general. So all we need you to do is be who you are and who you are is good enough. The outside noise doesn't matter. The outside noise has no impact on the job that he has to do, what his teammates think of him, what his coaching staff thinks of him.
